about_the_game:
Relive your favorite moments and connect with your favorite characters through the Original Soundtrack from The Haunting of Joni Evers!

Statement from composer Gustavo Coutinho (Payday 2 and Payday 3, Reaching for Petals):

"It was an absolute pleasure to work on this soundtrack and underscore the relationship between Joni and her family. It gave me plenty of opportunities to develop specific themes for each of the characters and have these themes converse. It's melancholic, atmospheric and also tense at some points. I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed working on it!"
